articles.title: Gatik brings in $200M to continue expanding autonomous trucking operations
articles.excerpt: Gatik said the funding will help it expand its model built around high-frequency regional routes connecting distribution centers and stores. The post Gatik brings in $200M to continue expanding autonomous trucking operations appeared first on The Robot Report.
